title: The report chart shows the same figures as the report table
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in on the build under test as an Admin user. The Admin role holds every permission, including Reports. To use another role, first check Settings > Roles & Permissions > that role: the Reports permission must be on.
  2. Pick one workplace in the workplace selector at the right of the top bar (e.g. QA Testing).
  3. Use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. At least two technicians can clock time: Settings > Staff > open each staff member > Edit Staff Member, Clockable switched on, Active, enrolled in this workplace (e.g. Grace Sullivan and Nadia Petrov).
  5. The workplace has technician time this month (the QA Testing workplace does). If not, seed one invoiced line with clocked time:
    • Customers > New Customer, enter a name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer") and save.
    • Work Orders > New Work Order, pick that customer and an asset (use Add in the dialog if the customer has no asset), then Create.
    • In the work order header set the service advisor (e.g. Marcus Halvorsen).
    • On the Lines tab click New Line and add a labor line with labor hours (e.g. 1.00) and a price (e.g. $250.00), and assign a technician to the line (e.g. Grace Sullivan).
    • Sign in as that technician in a second browser, clock in on that line, and clock out after a known time (e.g. 15 minutes, which is 0.25 hours). Sign out of the second browser.
    • Back as Admin: approve the line, complete the work order and click Review.
    • Open the Finance tab and click Create Invoice. The invoice is dated today. Close the payment dialog that opens.
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top bar and click Technician Utilization in the left menu.
  2. Set the Date control to This month.
  3. In the Technician filter keep one technician (e.g. Nadia Petrov).
  4. Hover the chart's point for this month and read the percent.
  5. Read that technician's Utilization % in the table.
  6. Click Sales in the left menu, set the Date control to This month and hover this month's bar.
  7. Read the Subtotal in the table's Totals row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Technician Utilization chart's point for this month shows the same percent as the technician's Utilization % in the table, allowing for the chart showing whole numbers (e.g. 70% on the chart for 70.23% in the table).
  • The Sales chart's bar for this month shows the same revenue as the report for this month, allowing for the chart showing whole dollars. Write both figures in the result comment.
